scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && npx prisma generate
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:push && npm run seed && npm run build:client
scripts.start: cd server && NODE_ENV=production npm run start
scripts.deploy:replit: npm run setup && npm run start
